what: Verified USB VR streaming on Quest 2 in the shared TheHumanTouch session with all three MetaHuman skinning settings enabled.
why: Virtual Scouting changing custom depth during mode transitions crashed the Mac editor. A workstation-local XR Creative mode keeps custom depth fixed and uses the existing Scouting avatar and tools.
details: Observed fresh H.265 frames on the headset at 2176 × 1200 with a negotiated 72 Hz refresh rate. The Quest 2 reports passthrough support. Camera passthrough was disabled in the streaming runtime and was not visually tested. The local ht-rejoin verifier recognizes both Quest 2 and Quest 3S.
